text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review - Notify Code Owner
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - epic
      - develop
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - labeled
jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test -- --run --coverage

      - name: Check for test failures
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Some tests failed. Please review the changes."
          exit 1

      - name: Notify code owner
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "All tests passed! No action needed."
```
